dct_description_sm: This study investigated whether these changes in threat processing and fear responses also affect pubertal laying hens, when they could modulate or exacerbate negative experiences specific to this life-stage. Pullets were raised with modified developmental trajectories (two growth rates and two ages at photostimulation) resulting in standard vs delayed puberty. A subset of naïve birds underwent a combined novel arena (NA) and novel object (NO) test at one of four times: pre-puberty, early puberty, late puberty, and post-puberty.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Coming of age: Changes in laying hen pullets’ threat processing and fear behavior
